description: List public class recordings (lecture audio with a transcript) that students shared for a course. Pass course_id from search-courses. Each recording has an artifact_id. An empty list means no one has shared a recording for this course yet.

course_id.description: Numeric course id from search-courses. Example: 1581710. A numeric string such as "1581710" is accepted.

limit.description: How many recordings to return. Integer from 1 to 20. Default 10.

name: list-course-recordings

course_id.description: Course id whose recordings were listed.

recordings.description: Public class recordings for this course, most recently updated first. Empty when none are shared yet.

artifact_id.description: Artifact id of the recording: studocu://project/{id}/source/{id}.

duration_seconds.description: Recording length in seconds. Null when the length is unknown.

project_id.description: Id of the public project that holds the recording.

title: List Course Recordings
